poses.desc: standing relaxed on the pitch in a light football ready stance, weight on one leg, hands loose at his sides, happy relaxed half-smile, looking to his RIGHT side of the frame

passing a football to a team mate off to the LEFT: the leg nearest the viewer is extended forward and across TOWARD THE LEFT SIDE OF THE FRAME in a short side-foot pass, ankle locked, arms out for balance, body and head turned to the LEFT, relaxed happy face

refusing without even looking: he keeps his eyes DOWN toward his own feet with a bored half-smile while his right arm is raised and his INDEX FINGER wags a clear NO, palm turned outward, the other hand on his hip

kicking a football HARD toward the LEFT SIDE OF THE FRAME: the leg nearest the viewer is swung high and fully extended out to the LEFT, the opposite arm thrown back for balance, torso leaning back, head turned LEFT, face fierce and determined
poses._beat: beat 2: chuta a bola no Arteta

poses.desc: frozen in shock, staring at something off to his LEFT: standing bolt upright and completely still, head clearly TURNED TO THE LEFT and eyes looking LEFT, arms hanging limp and forgotten at his sides, EYES WIDE OPEN and huge, eyebrows raised high, mouth slightly open, hypnotised
poses._beat: beat 3: congela ao ver o trofeu

poses.desc: deep in thought: his right hand is up cradling his chin between thumb and index finger, the other arm folded across his chest, eyebrows knitted, eyes narrowed and looking slightly up and to the RIGHT, weighing something heavy

a salesman offer: holding an OPEN briefcase in both hands out in front of him, tilted toward the viewer, the case CRAMMED with stacks of banknotes, a wide hopeful sales grin, eyebrows raised, facing RIGHT, wearing his BRIGHT RED training jacket with three white stripes (RED training jacket, never black)

a bigger offer: struggling under a huge stack of THREE overflowing suitcases packed with bundles of banknotes, gold bars and jewels piled on top, held in both arms up against his chest, knees slightly bent under the weight, a desperate pleading grin, facing RIGHT, wearing his BRIGHT RED training jacket with three white stripes (RED training jacket, never black)
poses._beat: beat 2: a segunda oferta, escalada de bens

poses.desc: no money at all this time: he holds up ONE object with both hands, presented reverently at chest height, a GOLDEN BALL TROPHY (a solid gold football mounted on a small dark plinth), his face calm, knowing and quiet, one eyebrow raised, facing RIGHT, wearing his BRIGHT RED training jacket with three white stripes (RED training jacket, never black)
standing relaxed on the training pitch, hands on his hips, laughing with his mouth open, enjoying the session, facing the viewer
worried and alarmed: both arms half raised and open in a questioning gesture, mouth open calling out to a team mate, eyebrows pulled up in concern, facing the viewer
standing relaxed on the training pitch, arms crossed, grinning wide, enjoying the session, facing the viewer
stunned: both hands on top of his head, mouth open in disbelief, eyes wide, staring straight ahead at the viewer
poses._nota: cabelo cacheado enorme e a marca dele

poses.desc: reaching out to take something: he stands calm and upright with his head turned LEFT, and the arm nearest the viewer is raised and extended straight out to the LEFT at chest height, the elbow gently bent, the HAND OPEN AND FLAT with all five fingers clearly drawn, relaxed and natural, palm turned slightly up as if about to receive an object; the other arm hangs at his side; eyes fixed LEFT, eyebrows raised, lips slightly parted, hesitating

refusing again, second frame of a wagging NO: same bored half-smile with his eyes DOWN toward his own feet, the raised hand kept at the SAME height near his shoulder but the INDEX FINGER now TILTED THE OTHER WAY (leaning to the opposite side), still clearly wagging no, the other hand on his hip

passing a football to a team mate off to the LEFT: the leg nearest the viewer extended forward and across TOWARD THE LEFT of the frame in a side-foot pass, arms out for balance, cheerful concentrated face; NO BALL is drawn, he kicks THIN AIR, there must be no football anywhere in the image

passing a football to a team mate off to the RIGHT: the leg nearest the viewer extended forward and across TOWARD THE RIGHT of the frame in a side-foot pass, arms out for balance, big grin, huge curly hair bouncing

cenarios.desc: an empty football TRAINING PITCH on a bright afternoon: flat green grass with mown stripes, a row of small orange training cones and a couple of white marker poles set back in the middle distance, a portable goal with netting off to one side, low advertising boards and an empty grey stand along the far side, a few tall floodlight masts and a warm hazy sky above
